comment: Frozen services-layer dependency edges - S1 initial baseline (runs/split ruling 2 of 2026-10-16; all 14 import statements re-verified line-by-line against the worktree at landing, 2026-10-24). Entries enumerate concrete edges src_file+dst_module (A-3 granularity); 'line' is provenance from the 2026-10-16 AST snapshot, matching is by src_file+dst_module so line drift never false-alarms. domain_pair is the grouping view used by module-map section 2b edge column (I-3, bidirectional reconciliation). kind: cross-domain = S1b exemption; layer = S1a exemption (only #13, the reverse dependency). Ratchet: only-shrink - adding an entry is a RED LINE (constraints.md, ask first), removing is free and expected (KPI: count -> 0). A cycle whose edges are all in this list = WARN on the per-entry 90-day clock (A-9 / A6 paradigm); an edge present in code but absent here = ERROR. Batch 1 (2026-10-24, P-037): 15 -> 12 entries - pdf_raster registered as the first shared leaf (P-038) dissolved kie->infra and document->infra; single_file_pipeline moved up into orchestration/ (ruling-2 'pipeline up' inversion) dissolved pipeline->L2. Batch 2 (2026-10-25, P-037): 12 -> 9 entries - both cycles broken (the graph is now acyclic): shared predicates promoted to leaves (text_first_contract + kie_default_rules) dissolved evidence->kie / hitl->kie / kie->hitl; kie->evidence stays as a ONE-WAY frozen edge (its dissolution needs orchestrator wiring, which sits at its 1297 ratchet cap - lands with the batch-3 orchestrator split instead of raising the pin). Batch 3 (2026-10-25, P-037): 9 -> 8 entries - kie->evidence dissolved: the orchestrator split gave the KIE step room to inject the grounding layer at the composition point, so kie.text_first no longer imports evidence at all. P-038 ruling D (2026-10-25): 8 -> 5 entries - page_text_trust registered as the fourth shared leaf (multi-domain text-layer measurement; E1 narrative stays with provenance-review.md), dissolving table->document and evidence->document (x2). P-038 ruling A+ (2026-10-25, revised from B the same day): 5 -> 4 entries - the seven-function box-geometry family moved verbatim from figure_service into shared leaf bbox_geometry (figure re-exports; table_pseudo_filter imports the leaf), dissolving table->figure - the A-12 worst form (cross-domain import of private symbols) is cleared. Batch 6 (2026-10-25, P-037): 4 -> 2 entries - table_cell_confidence registered as the sixth shared leaf (pure per-cell confidence measurement; consumed by layout's parse path, proof_report's summary card and orchestration/steps/extraction, with ZERO table-domain consumers - its table placement was historical naming from P-027 D8). The allowlist target's 'move module or invert' adjudication resolved as MOVE: inversion is structurally impossible (the raw table_res_list engine payload only exists at layout's _parse_result call site, so inverting would change the element data contract = tier C + GPU surface), and relocating into the layout domain would create a new report->layout edge (red line). Dissolves layout->table and report->table together.
